package.name: paxini_raw_hardware
package.description: Sole owner of the Paxini tactile sensor serial bus. Reads both the resultant and full per-taxel distributed force data for every supported sensor and publishes them directly on fixed, absolute, real-time-friendly topics -- entirely outside of ros2_control -- since routing hundreds of per-taxel scalars through ros2_control's state-interface mechanism does not scale.
